title: Justin Timberlake Posts Sweet Summer Catch-Up Photo Roll Featuring Wife Jessica Biel and Adorable Pics of Sons Phineas and Silas
summary: Six-year-old Phin's face is obscured by a massive ice cream sundae, while Silas joins in on what looks like an epic summer break.
contentText:
It looks like Justin Timberlake and Jessica Biel made the most of the summer break with their two boys. In a sweet Instagram post from the “Mirrors” singer on Tuesday (Aug. 18) captioned “Been outside,” Timberlake, 45, shared a series of pics of what the fam has been up to over the past few months, from rodeos to massive ice cream treats and, of course, dad’s favorite past time: golf.

The reel opened with a shot of Timberlake and Biel posing in going-out wear, with the actress modeling a floor-length, copper-colored body-hugging dress and Justin snugged up beside her with his hand on her hip as he rocks a baggy gray suit and shades.

The couple, who have steadfastly kept their children’s faces off social media, kind of broke the rule in the post, which featured a cute shot of 6-year-old Phineas peeking out from behind an ice cream sundae the size of his head. The little guy’s eyes were just visible above the cherry on top as he prepared to dig into the treat while wearing a blue polo and a bright orange baseball hat.

Phineas also appeared to have attended a rodeo based on a snap of him from behind checking out the action while wearing a black cowboy hat. The reel ended with a shot of Justin giving Phin a pat on the head as they walked down a fairway, with each carrying their own golf bag on a beautifully sunny day.

Elsewhere, Silas, 11 and his dad checked out a cool exhibit at New York’s Mercer Labs art and technology museum and all three Timberlake men gazed out a window as seen from behind. Though other snaps didn’t detail where the family spent their time off, one depicted a gorgeous running river in a green meadow, while another found Biel proudly holding up a fish she seemingly caught in the lake behind her.

There were also snaps of what looked like a fun pirate-themed birthday party, with a gang of swashbucklers sitting around a large table piled with presents and pirate gear.

Timberlake has been laying low since ending his Forget Tomorrow world tour last July and revealing that he’d been battling Lyme disease symptoms on the outing. He popped out in January, though, to honor Pharrell Williams at the Recording Academy Honors Black Music Collective event in Los Angeles. Timberlake dropped his sixth solo album  Everything I Thought It Was , in 2024; the LP reached No. 4 on the  Billboard 200  that March.
